extraction.Name: Thomas Wright
extraction.Buyer: Jack Martin loaned him $800.00 and took a mortgage on the place; George Smith subsequently purchased the land
extraction.NOTES: This is a questionnaire taken from Chris Colombe (also spelled Colome/Colombo), age 55, a third party, sworn before Notary Public Jas. W. Crows on June 18, 1929 (commission expires 4-28-32). Colombe states that in winter of 1923, he and Jack Martin went to Thomas Wright's place to purchase his land but could not agree on a price; Jack Martin then loaned Wright $800.00 by check and took a mortgage on the place. Before Martin and Colombe could return to negotiate a purchase, George Smith had purchased the land. Colombe does not know what Smith paid. References a separate affidavit by Thomas Wright dated June 6, 1929.
